In this video, we go behind the scenes to learn what led the Databricks Research team to develop OfficeQA, and watch as AI Agents are evaluated in real time at the Grounded Reasoning Cup. Which teams came out ahead? Watch to find out.

juiCQb_iQIY.title: Databricks ZeroOps
juiCQb_iQIY.label: DAIS 2026
juiCQb_iQIY.description:
In this live demonstration from the Databricks Data + AI Summit, see how Databricks Genie ZeroOps revolutionizes how data engineering and operations teams manage production pipelines.

Instead of flooding your screen with red lights and endless alerts, Genie ZeroOps introduces a clean, prioritized inbox-style interface. It automatically groups related failures into a single incident, saving data engineers hours of sorting through duplicate noise.

In this video, you'll see a live walkthrough of:

Autonomous Investigation: How background AI agents immediately diagnose silent data drops and upstream errors before you even log in.

Lineage-Driven Blast Radius: How the system traces Unity Catalog data lineage forward and backward to accurately identify the exact root cause (fan_interactions table) and mark downstream business impacts as critical.

Risk-Free Sandboxed Testing: Watch Genie ZeroOps automatically spin up an isolated sandbox using a zero-copy shallow clone of production data to safely deploy, test, and verify the exact code fix.

One-Click Pull Requests: Transition seamlessly into your standard software development lifecycle (SDLC) by generating a verified PR with a single click.
